title: Schedule runs name worktrees and branches from the full schedule and run ids, and stale-branch cleanup parks a branch with commits instead of deleting it (SESSION-WORKTREE-1/3, DISCORD-SCHEDULE-3)
description: Schedule runs name worktrees and branches from the full schedule and run ids, and stale-branch cleanup parks a branch with commits instead of deleting it (SESSION-WORKTREE-1/3, DISCORD-SCHEDULE-3)
acceptance_criteria: every schedule run gets its own worktree dir and talk/ branch named from the full schedule and run ids, so a later run never deletes an earlier run's commits and two concurrent schedules never share a worktree; stale-branch cleanup renames a branch with commits not on HEAD to BRANCH-parked-TIMESTAMP instead of force-deleting it
